name: secret-broker
description: mTLS Secret Broker with SOPS-backed credentials, proxy-mode for AI clients

scripts.test:v4: npm run test:redact && npm run test:mfa && node ../broker-test/test-auth-flow-security.js && npm run test:sms && npm run test:apikeys-v4 && node ../broker-test/test-master-key.js
scripts.test:security-core: npm run test:acl && node ../broker-test/test-runtime-config.js && node ../broker-test/test-local-health.js && node ../broker-test/test-trusted-proxy.js && node ../broker-test/test-proxy-guard.js && node ../broker-test/test-service-test-policy.js && node ../broker-test/test-typed-operation-executor.js && node ../broker-test/test-routes-phase-b2.js && node ../broker-test/test-auth-flow-security.js && npm run test:apikeys-v4 && npm run test:v4-modules && node ../broker-test/test-master-key.js && npm run test:mfa && npm run test:signing
scripts.test:p2: npm run test:workload && npm run test:ssh && npm run test:ws
scripts.test:verify: npm run test:modular && npm run test:acl && npm run test:signing && npm run test:v4-modules && npm run test:workload && npm run test:ssh && npm run test:ws
scripts.test:python-sdk: cd ../sdk/python && python -m pip install --quiet -r requirements-dev.txt && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp .pytest-tmp && cd ../../broker
scripts.test:verify-all: npm run test:verify && npm run test:python-sdk
scripts.test:modular: npm run test:lib && npm run test:ip && npm run test:routes && npm run test:obs && npm run test:trace && npm run test:ops && npm run test:backup && npm run test:v4
